name: Color contrast
summary: WCAG contrast ratio of two colors
author: friday-core
description: Computes the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio of two colours (hex, rgb, hsl or a colour name), the AA and AAA verdicts for normal text, large text and interface parts, and, when normal-text AA fails, the nearest lightness of the same hue that passes. With one colour it converts between hex, rgb and hsl.
